109:
SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    string_agg(s."system_name", ', ' ORDER BY s."system_name") AS systems
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
GROUP BY
    its."id", its."name";
110:
SELECT
    its.id AS it_specialist_id,
    its.name AS it_specialist_name,
    s.system_name,
    s.is_active
FROM
    it_support_specialists its
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        s.system_name,
        s.is_active
    FROM
        it_support_specialists_systems iss
    JOIN
        systems s ON iss.system_id = s.system_id
    WHERE
        iss.it_specialist_id = its.id
) s;

SELECT
    i."id" AS internship_id,
    i."title" AS internship_title,
    r."responsibility" AS responsibility
FROM
    "internships" i
JOIN
    "internships_responsibilities" ir ON i."id" = ir."internshipid"
JOIN
    "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id";

    its."id" AS specialist_id,

    s."system_id",
    sys."system_name"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its

SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS min_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years
FROM
    "jobs" j
ORDER BY
    j."salary" DESC
LIMIT 1;
